paragraphs: monday.com sells project management software for running projects and teams online. The about page presents it as one platform for any use case.

Coordination runs through a dynamic calendar and Gantt charts. Documents and conversations are centralized in one place, available at any time. A team can automate its workflow. Outside tools can be integrated into that workflow. The about page says the business kept evolving into a multi-product company.

Co-founders Roy Mann and Eran Zinman experienced firsthand the challenges that come with quickly scaling organizations. The timeline records monday.com ringing the bell and officially becoming a publicly-traded company on Nasdaq. It also notes surpassing 100,000 customers around the world managing their work on monday.com. A French customer page collects case studies, among them an account of how Transdev saved on recurring expenses. The about page navigation lists government among its industry pages.

quote.text: Built for teams and agents working together
